name: CheckboxGroup
description: A labeled set of related checkboxes in a fieldset, with a shared hint and error, an optional select-all box, columns and a cards layout. Each option is a Checkbox; the value is the array of checked values.

props.name: options
props.description: The options: strings, or { value, label, description, disabled } objects.

props.name: value
props.description: The checked values. Livewire binds it with wire:model (an array property), Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initially checked values of an uncontrolled group.

props.name: label
props.description: The group label, rendered as the fieldset's legend.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the options, linked to the group with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the group invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the group invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every option, and select all.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stacks the options or wraps them in a row. Emitted as data-orientation.

props.name: variant
props.description: Plain checkboxes, or bordered cards that are clickable anywhere. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: columns
props.description: Lays vertical options out in 1, 2 or 3 columns. Emitted as data-columns.

props.name: selectAll
props.description: Adds a select-all checkbox before the options. It shows the mixed state while some, not all, are checked.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: The select-all checkbox's label. Translated by default.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { items: '…', label: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The group: legend, select all, items, hint and error.

parts.name: selectAll
parts.description: Holds the select-all Checkbox, which takes the indeterminate state while some options are checked.

parts.name: items
parts.description: The options, each a Checkbox (.apui-checkbox) whose native input gets the group's attributes.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The checked values changed, in option order. Select all reports every enabled option, or none.

keyboard.action: Moves between select all and the checkboxes.

requirements: A fieldset and legend group native checkboxes; each option is a Checkbox with its own label.
Hint and error are linked to the fieldset with aria-describedby; invalid sets aria-invalid on each checkbox.
Select all is a real checkbox with the mixed (indeterminate) state while some options are checked.
Cards are clickable anywhere: the label covers the card.
Use RadioGroup for mutually exclusive options.

parts.hint: We never send more than one email a day.
